status_rules.finished_perfect: Only an owner explicitly listed status=finished_perfect in a completion ledger merged on main can be removed from remaining_to_perfect. Source persistence, runtime presence, a visual PASS for a partial feature, or an open PR is insufficient.
status_rules.started_open_pr: Owner is explicitly referenced by a non-source-only open PR and is inside postal canton 1000.
status_rules.source_registered_main: Owner is source-persisted on current production or belongs to the merged C01 immutable source campaign, but has no finished_perfect ledger entry.
status_rules.source_draft: Owner belongs to the active C02 source-only draft and is not yet production source truth.
status_rules.unstarted: Owner is in the official 1000 building inventory but has no production source registration, active implementation reference, or finish marker found by this audit.
status_rules.unresolved: Official 1000 building owner cannot be reconciled with planner/repository evidence and remains fail-closed rather than guessed.
